scope: Proposition 4.3 (Interpolation of the pairing) of the manuscript “Polynomial vacuum representations and bridge mass for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Polynomial-vacuum-representations-and-bridge-mass-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 69885ae7308d1f03), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix κ ̸= 0 and put η = κ + κ−1. The family Xn,m is uniquely determined among rational functions by the following properties. It is symmetric separately in its two blocks, and S2 N Xn,m is polynomial of degree at most 2(N − 1) in each site, where N = n + m. Within block A its reductions are Xn,m(a, Ta, A′ ; B) = Xn−2,m(A′ ; B), Xn,m(a, t2 a, A′ ; B) = Xn−1,m(ta, A′ ; B), lim a→0 or ∞ Xn,m(a, A′ ; B) = Xn−1,m(A′ ; B), The pair reductions require n ≥ 2, and the extreme reduction requires n ≥ 1; the analogous rules hold in block B with m in place of n. The initial value is X0,0 = 1, and at every balanced size n = m > 0, Xn,n(a1, . . . , an; Tan, . . . , Ta1) = (1 + η)n .
